tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Classification of components of Omega disjoint from $\Omega _\rho $] ↗ lem:canonical-neighborhoods-at-time-T ↗ def:omega-rho If a component $\Omega ^0$ contains no point of $\Omega _\rho $, it is one of:

  1. a strong double $2\epsilon $-horn, diffeomorphic to $S^2\times \Ar $;

  2. a $2C$-capped horn, diffeomorphic to $\Ar ^3$ or punctured $\Ar P^3$;

  3. a compact union of two cap cores and a tube, diffeomorphic to $S^3$, $\Ar P^3$, or $\Ar P^3\# \Ar P^3$;

  4. a compact $2\epsilon $-round component of constant positive curvature;

  5. a compact component fibering over $S^1$ with fiber $S^2$; or

  6. a compact $2C$-component diffeomorphic to $S^3$ or $\Ar P^3$.

Proof

↗ lem:canonical-neighborhoods-at-time-T ↗ epstopology\sketch Every point has a $(2C,2\epsilon )$-canonical neighborhood. The round and component alternatives give cases (4) and (6); otherwise Proposition epstopology classifies the neck and cap alternatives as (1)–(3) or (5).

□
